name: kaiju-4-rage
prompt: Generate an image. The attached picture shows MOTHBALL, a character from my cartoon party game. Draw the SAME character in exactly the same design, colours and art style (bold chunky cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colours, soft cel shading), but in KAIJU MODE: roaring furiously with its mouth wide open, angry eyebrows, its big sugar-glass moth wings flared wide, a few small WHITE puffs of powdered sugar flying off. NO glow, NO aura, NO pink or purple haze around it, clean outlines. Three-quarter view facing RIGHT, one full-body character centred filling about 80% of the frame, solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground shadow, no text. Square 1:1.
